configurePresets.name: x86-sde-release
configurePresets.description: The default configuration: SDE frontend, optimised, libtorch on.

configurePresets.name: x86-sde-debug
configurePresets.description: Same, unoptimised. Coexists with the release build; -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE now actually rebuilds.

configurePresets.name: x86-pin-release
configurePresets.description: The plain Pin kit rather than SDE. Needs: deps/sniper-deps --frontend pin fetch

configurePresets.name: x86-modern-abi
configurePresets.description: libtorch off, so the tree builds without -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0. The legacy ABI is forced only by the pre-cxx11 libtorch build; this is the configuration to test before dropping it everywhere.

configurePresets.name: riscv-release
configurePresets.description: RISC-V decoder. Needs an rv8 checkout: deps/sniper-deps --riscv fetch, or -DSNIPER_RV8_HOME=<path>

configurePresets.name: arm64-frontend
configurePresets.description: For the ARM board: builds sift and the DynamoRIO frontend, no x86 simulator. Build with --target dr_frontend. README.arm64 walks through this by hand today.
